text_block_list.text: Their argument has a lasting effect on Daiwa Scarlet, whose performance on the track begins to slump.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her running reflects the anxiety in her heart. Seeing her condition, I decide to…
choice_data_list: Enter her in the Japanese Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I decide to stick to the path Daiwa Scarlet has chosen and prepare for the Japanese Oaks, aiming for a conquest of the Tiara tour.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I prepare to enter her in the Japanese Derby, where she will face off against Vodka.
